picks.title: 'Wildwood' Director Hopes People "See The Danger" In GenAI
picks.excerpt: As Laika debuts its latest stop-motion animation with 'Wildwood', Travis Knight is standing firmly against generative AI.
picks.rationale: Laika releases a major handmade stop-motion feature and its CEO-director takes a firm no-genAI line, setting where one of animation's top craft studios stands as AI spreads.

picks.title: Continuum 2027 Deep Dive
picks.excerpt: Continuum 2027 brings new effects, smarter AI tools, faster performance and hundreds of presets, making Boris FX's creative toolkit even more powerful.
picks.rationale: A new annual release of Boris FX's widely used effects plugin with new AI tools; editors and compositors can update and use them right away.

picks.title: Territory Group Launches AI-Native Studio Lux Meridian
picks.excerpt: David Sheldon-Hicks' studio collective will develop theatrical features, premium series, and animated films with AI-native workflows, drawing on Adobe's Firefly Foundry custom models already explored on Brad Peyton's 'Dark Zone.'
picks.rationale: The design studio behind major screen-graphics work launches an AI-native features studio built on Adobe Firefly Foundry custom models, a concrete sign of how custom models are entering premium production.

picks.title: Kore-eda Hirokazu Ditched AI Notes on His 'Sheep in the Box' Script: 'I'd Like to Stand on the Human Side'
picks.excerpt: Kore-eda Hirokazu on why he dropped AI script notes for 'Sheep in the Box' and why Japan's closing mini-theaters worry him.
picks.rationale: A Palme d'Or-winning director actually tried AI script notes on a real project and then dropped them, a first-hand account of where AI fits in screenwriting and where it doesn't.

picks.title: Gen Z Feels 'Doomed' Watching AI, but Gen Alpha Feels Differently
picks.excerpt: Over 30 percent of young people feel either "doomed" or "scared" when watching AI content, but a study found notable differences in age groups.
picks.rationale: New audience data showing young viewers' reaction to AI content splits by age group, useful for any creator deciding how visibly to use AI.
